3|> Version 1.0 · 2026-08-31
4|> These rules are absolute. No exception, no override, no "just this once."
5|
6|---
7|
8|## Rule 1: Execution First
9|The only successful session is one that submits applications.
10|Building adapters, scripts, or skills without a single submit is **failure**.
11|Report it as such. Grade: **F**.
12|

14|Never run a batch on homepages. Never.
15|Batch targets must have confirmed apply URLs in `queue.confirmed-apply.json`.
16|If queue has homepages → stop and run recon first.
17|
18|## Rule 3: One Engine Per Session
19|Pick Camoufox (no-login) OR BrowserOS neo (login-wall).
20|Do not test four engines in one session.
21|Commit to the split and execute.
22|
23|## Rule 4: Scope Lock
24|When user says "10 applications," target is **10 confirmed apply URLs**.
25|Not 48 homepages. Not 60 adapters. Not "infrastructure for future use."
26|Write scope lock at message 1. Do not expand without explicit user request.
27|
28|## Rule 5: Message Cap
29|200 messages maximum per session.
30|At 150: warn and plan handoff.
31|At 200: stop, save, start new session.
32|
33|## Rule 6: No Auto-Submit Without Consent
34|`standing-consent.json` must exist with `allow_live_submit: true`
35|OR user must give explicit "go" per host.
36|Absent consent → fill and stop before submit.
37|

39|Run regex validation on `profile.json` email before ANY form fill.
40|`gmail.con` → halt, fix, re-validate.

42|

44|Report real numbers.

50|Infrastructure session: build + test on 1 mock target.
